new.title: Climb to Tophane Park for the clock tower and city view
new.desc: Tophane Park sits inside the old citadel walls above the city. Its six-storey, 33 m clock tower dates from 1905 and a ledge at the north end looks over the Bursa plain and the Uludağ foothills.
new.tip: Come in the late afternoon and take tea at the park cafés. Free to enter.
new.q: Tophane Saat Kulesi, Tophane Parkı, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Walk through the Imperial Gate of Bursa's citadel walls
new.desc: Saltanat Kapısı, the Imperial Gate, was the main gate of pre-Ottoman and early Ottoman Bursa, restored by Sultan Mehmed I in 1418. The surviving walls of the citadel run around the Hisar quarter.
new.tip: Follow the walls clockwise toward Tahtakale and Yerkapı gates. Free and always open.
new.q: Saltanat Kapısı, Hisar, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Visit the Dungeon Gate museum on the castle walls
new.desc: The Zindan Kapı, a prison until the late 19th century, reopened in 2021 as a free museum built into the citadel walls. It lies at the end of Kalebahçe Street, where locals have built homes against the ramparts.
new.tip: Pair it with a walk along Kalebahçe Sokak. Check opening days before going.
new.q: Zindan Kapı, Kalebahçe Sokak, Hisar, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Find the old plane tree at Kavaklı Mosque in Hisar
new.desc: The Kavaklı Mosque on Kavaklı Avenue dates from the reign of Murad I and is known for a plane tree thought to be among the oldest in Bursa. It stands among medreses and tombs in the walled Hisar quarter.
new.tip: Continue downhill to the Üftade Mosque and the Yerkapı Gate. Free.
new.q: Kavaklı Camii, Kavaklı Mahallesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Step inside the Ottoman House Museum near Muradiye
new.desc: A 17th-century Bursa house beside the Muradiye complex, furnished as a family home. It is believed to stand on the site of the palace of Sultan Murad II.
new.tip: Combine it with the Muradiye tombs next door and confirm opening hours.
new.q: Osmanlı Evi Müzesi, Muradiye Mahallesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: See Ottoman costumes and jewellery at the Uluumay Museum
new.desc: The museum opened on 18 September 2004 in the Şair Ahmet Paşa Medrese in Muradiye. It shows the private collection of Esat Uluumay, with traditional Ottoman-era garments and about 400 pieces of jewellery from Bursa and the region.
new.tip: Allow an hour and check current opening hours.
new.q: Uluumay Osmanlı Halk Kıyafetleri ve Takıları Müzesi, Muradiye, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Sip tea in the courtyard of Emir Han
new.desc: Emir Han is a caravanserai built for Orhan Gazi's complex and described as the first city khan in Anatolian Turkish architecture. Its courtyard tea garden has an old fountain and a view of the Ulu Cami.
new.tip: Sit by the central pool near the back entrance by the Ulu Cami and order a tea.
new.q: Emir Han, Ulu Mahallesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: See the Sinan Pasha complex in Yenişehir
new.desc: The Ottoman complex in Yenişehir centres on the Sinan Paşa mosque and caravanserai, one of several Ottoman monuments in a district that also has the Saray and Çifte hamams.
new.tip: Stop here on the way between Bursa and Bilecik. Check what is open before going.
new.q: Sinanpaşa Külliyesi, Namazgâh Caddesi No:1, Yeni Mahalle, Yenişehir, Bursa

new.title: Visit Orhan Gazi's 14th-century mosque at Yarhisar
new.desc: Orhan Bey built a complex at Yarhisar in 1339-1340, in his father's homeland, with a mosque, medrese, hamam and inn; the mosque and fountain are still in use. A village clock tower stands nearby.
new.tip: Combine it with the Cennet Kanyonu valley nearby. Dress modestly.
new.q: Orhan Gazi Camii, Yarhisar, Yenişehir, Bursa

new.title: Explore the Dr. Ceyhun İrgil Health Museum in Nilüfer
new.desc: The museum opened in 2024 and holds the collection of the former Bursa Health History Museum, which closed in 2020. It traces the history of medicine in the city.
new.tip: Check opening hours first as it is a newer museum.
new.q: Dr. Ceyhun İrgil Sağlık Müzesi, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Find the Roman fortress that gave Kestel its name
new.desc: The town of Kestel is named after a fortress, Kastel, built in the Roman period. Its remains overlook the district east of Bursa.
new.tip: Check local access before climbing; the site is little developed.
new.q: Kestel Kalesi, Kestel, Bursa

new.title: Look for the Kurşunlu Monastery on the Gemlik coast
new.desc: Kurşunlu Manastırı is listed among the sights of the Gemlik Gulf coast, near the village and beach of Kurşunlu.
new.tip: Pair it with a swim at Kurşunlu beach in summer.
new.q: Aziz Aberkios Manastırı (Kurşunlu Manastırı), Kurşunlu, Gemlik, Bursa

new.title: Eat İskender at the blue-fronted Kebapçı İskender
new.desc: The Mavi Dükkan on Atatürk Caddesi is run by grandchildren of İskender Efendi, the cook credited with inventing the dish in 1867. Thin-sliced döner on pide is covered with tomato sauce and melted butter.
new.tip: Go before noon at weekends; the sütlü kadayıf makes a good finish.
new.q: Kebapçı İskender Mavi Dükkan, Atatürk Caddesi No:60, Orhanbey, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Order İskender at Kebapçı Hüseyin Usta
new.desc: A small İskender house on Tuzpazarı Caddesi in the old bazaar quarter, serving thin-sliced döner on pide with tomato sauce and butter, plus pides.
new.tip: Reviewers mention free dessert and ayran with the meal. It is close to Koza Han, so combine it with the bazaar.
new.q: Kebapçı Hüseyin Usta, Tuz Pazarı Caddesi 16/B, Alacamescit, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Try İskender at Kebapçı Tamer in Nilüfer
new.desc: A Nilüfer İskender house on İzmir Yolu with free valet parking and vegetarian and gluten-free options, including rye-bread döner.
new.tip: Handy if you are staying on the Nilüfer side of the city.
new.q: Kebapçı Tamer, İzmir Yolu Caddesi No:102/3, İhsaniye, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Share Bursa kebab dishes at Beyler Kebap
new.desc: A group-friendly kebab house on Gümüşçeken Caddesi, with a menu that includes pideli köfte for sharing.
new.tip: Order a few dishes to share.
new.q: Beyler Kebap, Gümüşçeken Caddesi No:3, Orhanbey, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Order only pideli köfte at Kebapçı İdris in Kayhan
new.desc: A Kayhan shop that serves a single dish, pideli köfte, named after İdris Usta with origins in 1937.
new.tip: Take it with ayran; expect a short wait at lunch.
new.q: Kebapçı İdris, Kayhan Caddesi, Kayhan Mahallesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Eat Kayhan köfte at Kayhan Köftecisi
new.desc: A pideli köfte house founded in 1999 in a small shop in Kayhan Çarşısı, with a branch around Eker Meydanı in Nilüfer.
new.tip: A mixed order is the usual advice.
new.q: Kayhan Köftecisi, Eker Meydanı, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Buy tahanlı bread at Tarihi İnanç Fırını
new.desc: A bakery on II. Murat Caddesi near Muradiye, about 65 years old, known for Bursa tahanlı and sourdough bread.
new.tip: Buy a tahanlı loaf and eat it by the Muradiye tombs.
new.q: Tarihi İnanç Fırını, II. Murat Caddesi, Muradiye, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Taste sourdough and chestnut sugar at Pasto
new.desc: A bakery-café on Hancı Caddesi making sourdough and hop-flower-yeast bread, chestnut sugar, pastries and cheesecake.
new.tip: Good for a coffee and pastry break.
new.q: Pasto, Hancı Caddesi No:6, Akpınar, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Eat Ottoman home cooking at Rumeli Kardeşler Sofrası
new.desc: A restaurant on Vardar Caddesi with a daily-changing menu of Ottoman and Bursa dishes, including chestnut mountain kebab and sour cherry lamb stew.
new.tip: Ask for the day's specials.
new.q: Rumeli Kardeşler Sofrası, Vardar Caddesi No:36, Gülbahçe, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Have lamb tandır at Hayat Lokantası
new.desc: A family lokanta open since 1947 serving lamb tandır, beef kavurma, chickpea and artichoke dishes, and süt helvası.
new.tip: Go at lunch for the full counter.
new.q: Hayat Lokantası, Stadyum Caddesi, Santral Garaj, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Eat cantık pide at Pidecioğlu
new.desc: A pide house serving cantık, small pide with cheese, minced meat or diced meat, plus tomato soup and sahan köftesi.
new.tip: Try the mixed cantık.
new.q: Pidecioğlu, Geçit 1. Gürbüz Sokak, Belen 3 Sitesi No:57, Geçit, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Taste oven-baked sütlaç at Tarihi İzzet Efendi
new.desc: A historic dessert shop on 1. Hamam Sokak known for oven-baked sütlaç, kazandibi, tavuk göğsü and süt helvası, with the house 'Dinamit' recipe.
new.tip: Come in the afternoon.
new.q: Tarihi İzzet Efendi Tatlıları, 1. Hamam Sokak No:2, Alacamescit, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Order muhallebi at Tarihi Bursa Muhallebicisi
new.desc: A pudding shop on Cumhuriyet Caddesi serving muhallebi in many flavours, kazandibi, tavuk göğsü and supangle.
new.tip: A good stop on a walk up Cumhuriyet Caddesi.
new.q: Tarihi Bursa Muhallebicisi, Cumhuriyet Caddesi No:74, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Buy baklava at Şengüloğlu Baklava Beşevler
new.desc: A Nilüfer baklava shop with yeşil burma, şöbiyet, cold baklava, börek and güllaç.
new.tip: Take a box of mixed baklava to go.
new.q: Şengüloğlu Baklava, Yıldırım Caddesi No:7/B, Konak, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Taste chestnut sugar at Ulus Pastanesi by the Ulu Cami
new.desc: A historic pastry shop on Atatürk Caddesi near the Ulu Cami known for chestnut sugar, Marşal Pasta and Anjelika jam.
new.tip: Buy gifts to go.
new.q: Ulus Pastanesi, Atatürk Caddesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Dine on Anatolian and Ottoman dishes at Zennup 1884
new.desc: A research-driven restaurant at Eker Meydan with an Anatolian, Ottoman and Mesopotamian menu, including Seljuk-style tandır and chestnut rice.
new.tip: Book ahead for dinner.
new.q: Zennup 1884, Lefkoşe Caddesi, Eker Meydan AVM, Çamlıca, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Reserve one of the 21 tables at 21 Masa
new.desc: A small restaurant in Bademli with 21 tables, house-made bread and tableware, and modern Anatolian cooking such as lamb fillet and Bursa kebab.
new.tip: Reserve ahead; it is small.
new.q: 21 Masa, Aydoğdu Sokak, Belen 2 Sitesi No:2, Bademli, Mudanya, Bursa

new.title: Grill lamb at Bademli Kasabı Ali Izgara Salonu
new.desc: A butcher-grill restaurant at the entrance of Bademli village serving grilled meatballs, chops, lamb skewers and slow-cooked lamb shank.
new.tip: Order the lamb shank tandır early in the day as it can sell out. Bademli is on the old Mudanya road.
new.q: Bademli Kasabı Ali Izgara Salonu, Eski Mudanya Caddesi No:24, Çağrışan, Bademli, Mudanya, Bursa

new.title: Drink rakı at Restoran Mimoza meyhane
new.desc: A meyhane on Mudanya Caddesi in Osmangazi, open daily from noon to 2 am.
new.tip: Go in the evening.
new.q: Restoran Mimoza, Mudanya Caddesi No:93D, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Taste pistachio baklava at Kahyaoğlu
new.desc: A sweet shop on 1. Çınar Caddesi known for pistachio baklava, şöbiyet and homemade lemonade.
new.tip: Try the şöbiyet.
new.q: Kahyaoğlu, 1. Çınar Caddesi No:24/B, Koğukçınar, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Eat profiteroles at Ülkü Pastanesi in İhsaniye
new.desc: A Nilüfer pastry shop with profiterole, keşkül, kazandibi, éclairs and chestnut cake.
new.tip: Take away a box.
new.q: Ülkü Pastanesi, Barbaros Caddesi, Çilek Sokak No:4/A, İhsaniye, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Try pastel de nata at Malina Bakery
new.desc: A bakery in Beşevler with pastel de nata, pistachio tart, San Sebastian cheesecake and almond croissants.
new.tip: Arrive early for croissants.
new.q: Malina Bakery, Beşevler Caddesi No:29/A, Konak, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Buy baklava at Fıstıkbeyi Baklava
new.desc: A baklava shop at Eker İş Merkezi selling pistachio baklava, şöbiyet and havuç dilimi.
new.tip: Good for gifts.
new.q: Fıstıkbeyi Baklava, Lefkoşe Caddesi, Eker İş Merkezi A Blok No:19/A-H, Odunluk, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Finish with muhallebi at Hacı Kayhan Tatlıları
new.desc: A dessert shop on FSM Bulvarı with muhallebi, kazandibi, trileçe and Belgian chocolate profiterole.
new.tip: Evening dessert stop.
new.q: Hacı Kayhan Tatlıları FSM, FSM Bulvarı, Bulvar Diamond A Blok No:86/45, Esentepe, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Watch Bursaspor at Timsah Arena
new.desc: The Bursaspor stadium opened in 2015 with a crocodile-shaped green roof. It holds about 43,000 and sits near Acemler metro station.
new.tip: Buy tickets on Passo; check which league Bursaspor plays in.
new.q: Timsah Arena, Acemler, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Soak at the Çelik Palas thermal spa
new.desc: A historic hotel on Çekirge Caddesi whose spa has a sauna, hamam and a pool filled with natural thermal water; day visitors are accepted.
new.tip: Private family baths cost extra; check prices.
new.q: Çelik Palas Termal, Çekirge Caddesi, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Bathe in the Muradiye Hamam
new.desc: A historic hamam listed among Bursa's Ottoman baths in the Muradiye quarter.
new.tip: Check opening hours first.
new.q: Muradiye Hamamı, Muradiye, Osmangazi, Bursa

new.title: Picnic at Dağyenice Pond in Nilüfer
new.desc: A pond at 510 m about 19 km from the city with picnic areas and an outdoor day facility nearby.
new.tip: Bring food and go on weekdays.
new.q: Dağyenice Göleti, Nilüfer, Bursa

new.title: Hike to Saitabat Waterfall in Kestel
new.desc: A waterfall in Kestel, east of Bursa, listed among the best-known falls of the region.
new.tip: Visit in spring when the flow is strongest.
new.q: Saitabat Şelalesi, Saitabat, Kestel, Bursa

new.title: Camp and walk at Kocayayla above Keles
new.desc: A plateau on the south face of Uludağ at 1,225 m, 4 km from Keles, with a camping and caravan facility.
new.tip: Cooler than the plain in summer.
new.q: Kocayayla Mesire Alanı, Keles, Bursa

new.title: Visit Görecik Plateau above Büyükorhan
new.desc: A plateau at 1,055 m, 4 km from Büyükorhan and 92 km from Bursa, host of the Turkmen and Yörük Festival every August.
new.tip: Best in August for the festival.
new.q: Görecik Yaylası, Büyükorhan, Bursa

new.title: Trek Cennet Kanyonu near Günece
new.desc: A canyon of about 6 km between the villages of Yarhisar and Günece with waterfalls and pools; a hard route to be done with an experienced guide.
new.tip: Go only with a guide and in the dry season.
new.q: Cennet Kanyonu, Günece, Yenişehir, Bursa

new.title: Swim on the Kurşunlu coast
new.desc: Kurşunlu Sahili is a coastal strip on the Gemlik Gulf listed among Bursa day trips.
new.tip: Go in summer.
new.q: Kurşunlu Halk Plajı, Kurşunlu, Gemlik, Bursa
